technical_and_design_decisions: System channel genesis block creation (U6) will be implemented as a separate public API function distinct from application channel genesis block creation to provide clear, purpose-built functionality for consumers.

The existing CreateSignedConfigUpdateEnvelope function will be renamed to SignConfigUpdateEnvelope, and the SigningIdentity interface will be extended to include both SignConfigUpdate and SignConfigUpdateEnvelope methods to encapsulate all config update signing functionality in a single interface.

All new config modification functions will reuse existing helper logic for group/org/policy operations used for other config groups to minimize code duplication and maintain consistency with existing package behavior.

All new and updated functions will follow existing Hyperledger Fabric Go coding conventions, including consistent error handling, input validation, and naming patterns aligned with the rest of the configtx package.
Example usage for all new functionality will be added to the existing example_test.go file in the configtx package, following the structure of existing examples to ensure consistency.
assumptions: The supporting functions for retrieving dependent config fields referenced in U1 are already fully implemented, tested, and stable, so the full channel config retrieval function only needs to compose these existing utilities.
Existing configtx package test infrastructure is sufficient to cover new functionality, with no need for major updates to test harnesses or mocking frameworks.

The configtx package's existing internal representation of consortiums, orderer orgs, application orgs, and policies is consistent enough that new removal/update functions can reuse existing traversal and modification logic without requiring structural changes to the config model.
No breaking changes to existing public APIs of the configtx package are required to implement the requested functionality, so existing consumer code will not be impacted by the changes.
The GoDoc generation tooling for the project is already configured, so adding the Overview section to the configtx package will not require changes to documentation build pipelines.
